title: malus sieversii subsp. kirghisorum
intro: Malus sieversii subsp. kirghisorum, commonly known as the Tien Shan apple, is a subspecies of apple native to the mountainous regions of Central Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and acting as an antimicrobial agent. The health benefits of Malus sieversii subsp. kirghisorum include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antidiabetic properties. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and ascorbic acid, which contribute to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
